column1: # The := slice, try a02: a01 plus the P0 parser and scanner (the token := -- a Frame flagged LM_P0_FRAME_ASSIGN of its left
# and right sides, compact or spaced), the frontend (the binder names a formal by the := Frame only -- a head matching a
# formal is the positional value it writes; is_asgn takes an := Frame as the write of its place whatever the head calls;
# the check refuses an := whose left side is no known place), the five fixtures whose named actuals move to :=, five new
# fixtures, the registry and the inputs list (244). Run by `lmxtool steps` with the working tool of boot164a: pinned, kept
# in variants/tp165, copied into the stage; the source manifest of the stage by the inputs list written, then checked.
